name: fix_node_redos_validator
description: Fixes a ReDoS: a slug validator regex with nested quantifiers backtracks exponentially on crafted input
prompts: isValidSlug(s) in validate.js should accept a slug of one or more lowercase ASCII letters (the whole string, a-z only). It uses the regex /^([a-z]+)+$/, whose nested quantifiers cause catastrophic backtracking: a crafted input like many letters followed by a non-letter takes exponential time (a ReDoS denial of service). Fix the regex so validation runs in linear time while accepting EXACTLY the same strings (one or more lowercase a-z letters, anchored to the whole string). Do not keep the nested-quantifier group. Keep the module export and the isValidSlug(s) signature.
